subinstance_selection.Q9_L: Greedy deterministic selection minimizing, in order, maximum P1 overlap with selected witnesses, total P1 overlap, repeated pair, shared part/supplier, shared order, then physical tuple key.
subinstance_selection.Q9_H: Choose part-supplier component by cyclomatic number, edge count and witness count; seed with highest-multiplicity pair, take at most six witnesses from it, then take witnesses from adjacent distinct pairs sharing part or supplier, then fill by maximum P1 overlap; physical tuple keys break ties.
